hard_deny: Never force-push, rewrite published git history, or delete branches.
Never run destructive filesystem commands (rm -rf and equivalents).
Never run anything with sudo or otherwise escalate privileges.
Never change git config, provider secrets, or environment variables in Vercel or Supabase.
Never reset, drop or truncate a database, and never delete production data.
Never bypass a commit hook or signature check (--no-verify, --no-gpg-sign).
Never edit .claude/settings.json itself without the user having asked for that change.
soft_deny: Writing to production data is not routine: an INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE against the live Supabase project needs the user to have asked for that specific change.
environment: This repository verifies its work with direct read-only SQL against the production Supabase project constantly: SELECTs, catalog reads (pg_constraint, information_schema) and log queries are ordinary, expected, non-destructive research.
The permissions.deny list in this same file is authoritative and stays in force independently of this classifier.
